scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive computations have a complete replayable verifier and explicit tree certificate. Mathematical all-size implication is separately proved; no independence or infinite computational certification is asserted.

title: The eight-position VC collapse and online entropy obstruction for two-descent permutations
